name: Tobias Kucera photo archive digitization and publication

mentions.name: Tobias Kucera photo archive digitization and publication
mentions.description: A public fundraiser to digitize and publish a large photo archive of a documentary photographer and political dissident from communist-era Czechoslovakia, with a planned web catalogue that would let anyone search the photographs by date, place, names, and other attributes.
mentions.problem: The photographer's historically valuable photo archive was never able to be published and needs digitization and publication.
mentions.audience: The general public, whom the author says should see the valuable photographs.
mentions.source_excerpt: My father, a documentary photographer and political dissident during communist regime in Czechoslovakia have a large photo archive that he was never able to publish. I have launched a public fundraiser to support the digitization and publication of the photo archive. There are many valuable photographs that public should see.
